title: Vijaya Kankana
desc: Four honest and fierce individuals Shankar, Vijaya, Naina, and Amar come together to fight against the corrupt officials who have been exploiting citizens.

title: Mayura
desc: Mayura, a Brahmin boy, discovers his connections to the royal family. He then takes it upon himself to avenge the death of his father and works towards building his kingdom.

title: Obba
desc: A man aspires to join the Indian Police Service. But when a business tycoon kills his sister, he strives to take revenge.

title: Aranmanai 3
desc: Jyothi, the daughter of a landlord, gets haunted by an unknown entity in her childhood. However, when the spirit begins to trouble another member of her family, she decides to uncover its identity.

title: Champion
desc: A lazy man must rise to the occasion when his brother lands in trouble. However, with two beautiful women chasing after him, the man struggles to make the right decisions.

title: Jai Simha
desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.
